megan (Eng): Heads up 11 I'm relocating from Boston MA to Hoboken NJ on 2026-05-15. Do I lose the $60 WFH stipend or is it moved? Any implications for state withholding / benefits network?
tess (People Ops): Congrats! :tada: Quick: stipend follows "work location" not mailing address, so update the Work Location field. Stipend won't stop unless you change to an in-office eligible category.
megan (Eng): I'm staying remote, just changing state.
logan (Payroll): If you're remaining remote, stipend continues. Tax withholding: MA -> NJ change will update state withholding; NJ has reciprocity rules for certain localities but in general we'll switch your state tax. Effective date: the payroll change goes in on the next payroll cycle if we get the update before the monthly cutoff (20th 11:59pm ET).
megan (Eng): My move date is 2026-05-15. If I submit on the 21st is the withholding change delayed?
tess (People Ops): Yes, if after cutoff it'll apply the following pay period. Also file the Location Change form so Benefits gets the event. Moving states is usually a qualifying life event for some carriers so you can request a mid-year plan change.
megan (Eng): Do I need to provide proof? lease/driver's?
hris-bot: HRIS action required: Upload proof for address change (lease, utility, or driver's license) under Profile > Documents. Failure to upload may delay benefits updates.
logan (Payroll): Extra note: if you contributed to MA state taxes earlier in the year, those withholdings remain for wages paid while MA-resident; we only change future withholding. If you want a projected estimate for partial-year tax exposure, we can connect you to our tax partner.
tess (People Ops): WFH stipend proration: company policy = monthly stipend prorated by active days in month when location change is effective in HRIS. Example: move 15th of 31-day month -> stipend = round((16/31)*60).
megan (Eng): OK filing now. Also curious: does this create any tax nexus triggers for benefits or headcount? manager asked.
tess (People Ops): Short answer: for individual moves no company-wide nexus changes. If we start hiring > X people in a state we'd evaluate nexus and payroll registration. Your move alone won't trigger that.
logan (Payroll): Ticket created #PAY-2026-2298 to process withholding and stipend proration for megan. ETA 1-2 business days after docs uploaded.
tess (People Ops): I'll follow up here once benefits receives the change and after payroll confirms. LMK if you need relocation assistance details (different approval path). :+1:
